question_en: Before performing a maintenance test on a high-voltage component, what does the RSOS require?
options: Isolate the component for the testing procedure and select diagnostic/test equipment appropriate to the task.
Leave it energized regardless of the test.
Use low-voltage assumptions only.
Skip risk assessment for insulating media.
explanation_en: B-14.02 requires isolation of components for testing and selection/use of appropriate diagnostic and test equipment.
explanation_es: B-14.02 exige aislar componentes para las pruebas y utilizar equipo de diagnóstico/prueba apropiado.

question_en: High-voltage maintenance results differ significantly from commissioning records. What is the correct evaluation basis?
options: Previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
Only the current room temperature.
Only the equipment paint condition.
Only whether the device is still energized.
explanation_en: B-14.02 requires test results to be evaluated against previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: B-14.02 exige evaluar resultados contra datos previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning.

question_en: A three-phase transformer turn-ratio test differs from previous maintenance results. What should the electrician do next?
options: Analyze the result against previous records, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation before determining maintenance.
Immediately change winding configuration.
Ignore it if secondary voltage is present.
Increase primary voltage to compensate.
explanation_en: Transformer maintenance results are evaluated using previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: Los resultados de mantenimiento del transformador se evalúan usando datos previos, especificaciones del fabricante y documentación de commissioning.

question_en: Inspection finds a damaged raceway support and a loose coupling. What action matches C-16.06?
options: Repair or replace damaged components and tighten/adjust loose components according to applicable requirements.
Paint over the damage.
Remove all supports from the run.
Ignore it if conductors still have continuity.
explanation_en: C-16.06 requires damaged raceway/enclosure components to be repaired/replaced and loose components tightened or adjusted.
explanation_es: C-16.06 exige reparar/reemplazar componentes dañados y apretar/ajustar componentes flojos.

question_en: A wiring device was replaced and the branch circuit now operates intermittently. What should the electrician do before closing the work order?
options: Test the branch circuitry and device, verify correct operation, and update documentation for changes made.
Assume the new component is correct because it is new.
Increase the branch breaker rating.
Remove the device label.
explanation_en: C-17.04 requires post-repair testing/verification and documentation updates.
explanation_es: C-17.04 exige pruebas/verificación después de la reparación y actualización de la documentación.

question_en: After replacing an HVAC electrical control component that contains programmed settings, what should be done?
options: Install an OEM or equivalent component, restore/reprogram the prior parameters, then test system operation.
Leave it at factory defaults without verification.
Bypass all interlocks.
Change the motor nameplate.
explanation_en: C-18.03 requires OEM/equivalent replacement, reprogramming to parameters prior to replacement, and post-repair testing.
explanation_es: C-18.03 exige reemplazo OEM/equivalente, reprogramación a los parámetros previos y pruebas posteriores.

question_en: An HVAC system stops intermittently. Which approach best matches the RSOS?
options: Verify component operation using field assessment and diagnostic tests, determine the malfunction source, repair/replace, then verify system operation.
Replace the VFD without testing.
Change thermostat settings until the fault disappears.
Ignore interaction between components.
explanation_en: C-18.03 requires verification, diagnosis using assessments/tests, repair/replacement and final system verification.
explanation_es: C-18.03 exige verificación, diagnóstico con evaluaciones/pruebas, reparación/reemplazo y verificación final del sistema.

question_en: After repairing an electric heating control, what is required before the system is returned to normal operation?
options: Test the heating system and controls to manufacturer/facility requirements and verify system operation.
Increase the temperature limit setting.
Remove the maintenance log entry.
Bypass the thermostat.
explanation_en: C-19.02 requires post-repair tests and verification of operation according to manufacturer and facility requirements.
explanation_es: C-19.02 exige pruebas posteriores y verificación de operación según el fabricante y requisitos de la instalación.

question_en: An electric heater does not reach setpoint. What is the correct maintenance approach?
options: Verify operation with field assessment/test equipment, determine the malfunction source, then repair or replace the defective component.
Replace every heater and control immediately.
Increase supply voltage without measurements.
Ignore temperature controls.
explanation_en: C-19.02 defines maintenance as verification, diagnosis from assessment/test results, repair/replacement and final testing.
explanation_es: C-19.02 define mantenimiento como verificación, diagnóstico con resultados de pruebas, reparación/reemplazo y prueba final.

question_en: After repair or component replacement in an exit/emergency lighting system, what must be done?
options: Test the system, verify operation to applicable manufacturer/AHJ/CSA/CEC requirements, and document the test results.
Test only normal lighting.
Remove the battery pack.
Leave the maintenance record unchanged.
explanation_en: C-20.02 requires post-repair/maintenance testing, verification and documentation of operational problems and test results.
explanation_es: C-20.02 exige pruebas posteriores, verificación y documentación de problemas/resultados.

question_en: A battery-backed emergency lighting unit operates normally on utility power but fails during the scheduled emergency test. What should guide the next action?
options: Use field assessment and diagnostic/test results to determine the source of malfunction, then repair or select an OEM/equivalent replacement and retest.
Assume it is acceptable because normal lighting works.
Disable the scheduled test.
Increase branch-circuit voltage.
explanation_en: C-20.02 requires diagnosis from field/test results, repair/replacement and retesting after maintenance.
explanation_es: C-20.02 exige diagnóstico con resultados de campo/prueba, reparación/reemplazo y nuevas pruebas después del mantenimiento.

question_en: During repair of a cathodic-protection system, why may a bypass jumper be installed?
options: To maintain continuity of protection during the repair.
To increase AC supply frequency.
To bypass all protective devices permanently.
To replace the reference electrode.
explanation_en: C-21.02 specifically requires bypass jumpers when needed to maintain continuity of cathodic protection during repair.
explanation_es: C-21.02 exige jumpers de bypass cuando sean necesarios para mantener la continuidad de protección durante la reparación.

question_en: A cathodic-protection reading is abnormal after component replacement. What should occur before the job is closed?
options: Test the repaired system/components, verify operation against manufacturer/facility/AHJ requirements, and document the results.
Ignore the reading if the AC breaker remains closed.
Remove the bypass jumper without checking system operation.
Change the rectifier tap randomly.
explanation_en: C-21.02 requires testing after repair and documentation of operational problems/test results.
explanation_es: C-21.02 exige pruebas después de la reparación y documentación de problemas/resultados.

question_en: A starter was repaired but its measured performance differs from specifications. What should decide whether further maintenance is required?
options: Analysis of the maintenance test results compared with specifications.
Whether the starter enclosure looks clean.
Only whether the motor starts once.
Only the age of the contactor.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires maintenance decisions to be based on analysis/comparison of test results with specifications.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige que las decisiones de mantenimiento se basen en el análisis/comparación de resultados con especificaciones.

question_en: An AC drive power component has been replaced. What should be done before returning the drive to service?
options: Adjust programming if required by the repair/operating conditions, then test the drive to manufacturer and facility requirements.
Set every parameter to maximum.
Delete the previous parameter set.
Bypass the drive protection.
explanation_en: D-23.02 requires programming adjustment where needed and post-repair testing to manufacturer/facility requirements.
explanation_es: D-23.02 exige ajustar programación cuando sea necesario y realizar pruebas posteriores según fabricante/instalación.

question_en: Which item is included in the RSOS range for “other fixed equipment”?
options: Conveyor.
Pressure transmitter only.
Portable ladder.
Fire extinguisher.
explanation_en: D-24 includes equipment such as welding equipment, electro-magnets, electrostatic precipitators, industrial equipment, x-ray equipment, conveyors and charging equipment.
explanation_es: D-24 incluye equipos como soldadura, electroimanes, precipitadores electrostáticos, equipos industriales, rayos X, transportadores y equipos de carga.

question_en: A conveyor control has failed and insulation/current tests are available. What should guide the maintenance decision?
options: Determine the fault from field/test results, repair or use OEM/equivalent replacement components, then test and analyze results against specifications.
Replace the conveyor mechanically without electrical tests.
Ignore baseline values.
Increase the protective-device setting.
explanation_en: D-24.02 requires diagnosis from assessments/tests, OEM/equivalent replacement where needed, post-repair testing, and comparison/analysis of results.
explanation_es: D-24.02 exige diagnóstico mediante evaluaciones/pruebas, reemplazo OEM/equivalente, pruebas posteriores y análisis de resultados.

question_en: A three-phase motor shows increasing vibration and a maintenance current trend different from baseline. What is the best RSOS-based response?
options: Analyze the maintenance test results against baseline/specifications, determine the source, and repair as required.
Ignore the trend until the motor trips.
Increase overload settings.
Change the nameplate FLC value.
explanation_en: D-25 maintenance uses tests such as vibration/current and requires comparison/analysis of maintenance results.
explanation_es: El mantenimiento D-25 usa pruebas como vibración/corriente y exige comparar/analizar los resultados.

question_en: During scheduled fire-alarm maintenance, how should test results be evaluated?
options: Using previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
Only by checking whether the panel display is lit.
Only against building occupancy.
They do not require evaluation.
explanation_en: E-26.02 requires fire-alarm test results to be evaluated using previous results, manufacturer specifications and commissioning documentation.
explanation_es: E-26.02 exige evaluar resultados de pruebas de alarma contra incendio con datos previos, especificaciones del fabricante y commissioning.
